COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_cancel_eng_simonstown = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SAF }
		SAF = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_eng_simonstown_signed
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_eng_simonstown_SAF } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_eng_simonstown_SAF }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = ENG }
		ENG = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_eng_simonstown_signed
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_eng_simonstown_ENG } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_eng_simonstown_ENG }
		}
	}
}
